title.quote: Learning Reliable Logical Rules with SATNet
title.justification: Title as given at the top of the paper.
title.value: Learning Reliable Logical Rules with SATNet

extractions.description: The paper proposes a framework to decode interpretable logical rules (as weighted MaxSAT formulas) from the learned weights of SATNet, via a "maximum equality" specification, plus verification techniques to check functional equivalence with ground truth rules. Experiments cover stream transformations (parity, binary addition, symbol counting) and 4x4 / 9x9 Sudoku puzzles.

type.quote: To evaluate the efficacy of our proposed framework, we conduct a series of experiments on various tasks, including stream transformations (i.e., the parity function, addition, and counting) and Sudoku puzzles.
type.justification: The paper includes propositions but its claims are mainly validated through experiments on stream transformations and Sudoku.

name.quote: we present a new framework that addresses this goal by generating interpretable and verifiable logical rules through differentiable learning

name.justification: Verification techniques are introduced to validate decoded rules.
